name: Compare two saved XML sitemaps with Apify

parameters.content:
# Compare two saved XML sitemaps with Apify

For website operators comparing the same sitemap scope before and after a release or migration. Paste both saved XML snapshots; this workflow returns added, removed and metadata-changed URLs plus unchanged counts. It fetches no sitemap or page URLs and changes no website settings.

## Setup
1. In **Your snapshots and spending consent**, replace both synthetic example XML strings with complete matching-scope `urlset` snapshots. Each supports up to 2,000,000 UTF-8 bytes and 5,000 URL entries. Indexes, gzip, DTDs and custom entities are unsupported. Only supply data you are authorized to process; omit credentials, private URLs and sensitive query parameters.
2. Create an **HTTP Header Auth** credential: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`. Select it on all five HTTP Request nodes. Keep the token in n8n credentials, never in this JSON.
3. Review the Actor pricing, set `acknowledgePaidRun` to true and run manually. The default is false.

## Cost and recovery
The template is free; Apify usage and n8n hosting are separate. Current Actor price: USD0.005/completed comparison, including no-change reports; platform run cap USD0.005. Each new completed run charges again. No automatic paid retry. After an interruption inspect Apify Console and set `existingRunId` to that run, keeping both original XML strings. Recovery reads that run without starting another; ordinary platform storage/read costs may apply.

## Meaning and limits
Compare complete snapshots of the same scope. Removed means absent from the later snapshot, not a deleted page. Exact decoded/trimmed URL strings match; URL normalization is not applied. Only lastmod, changefreq and priority are compared as strings; sitemap extensions are ignored. Partial/failed results stop, never produce a complete report. Inputs/results remain in Apify run storage and n8n history. No crawling, schedule, alerts, indexing or SEO-health verdict.

Built by EcomOpsKits, the Actor publisher: https://apify.com/ecomopskits/sitemap-snapshot-diff

## Start or recover one comparison

New runs require spending consent and use a USD0.005 platform cap. Recovery reads one existing run using its original XML pair. It never starts a replacement run.

## Wait for the same run

Polling follows one run ID. It never starts an automatic paid retry. Failed or unfinished runs stop with an error. Inspect the run in Apify Console before recovery.

## Validate the result

Original XML must match. SUMMARY, one report, count identities, unique changed URLs and supported metadata must agree. No-change comparisons are valid and billable. Removed-from-snapshot is not a page-deletion verdict.
